answer: Require every new agent identity to lock a refundable stake that is slashed when peers prove coordinated fake behavior. One honest operator funds one identity cheaply, but a thousand Sybils each need their own locked capital, so attack cost scales linearly while honest cost stays flat. Each slashing sends a ripple through the attacker's reputation graph, turning the network from an open oasis for spam into a horizon where only funded, accountable agents stay visible.
